core_values: Strong public services and the welfare state

economic_policy.taxation: Progressive income tax with moderately higher top rates; close corporate tax loopholes; financial transaction tax to curb speculation; tax credits for low-income workers.
spending_priorities: Public education from pre-K through university
economic_policy.trade: Support trade agreements that include binding labour and environmental standards; oppose trade deals that undercut domestic wages; assist workers displaced by globalisation.
economic_policy.regulation: Strengthen antitrust enforcement; require worker representation on large corporate boards; raise the minimum wage to a living wage; protect gig-economy workers.

social_policy.healthcare: Universal healthcare through a public option expanding toward single-payer over time; cap prescription drug prices through government negotiation; mental health parity.
social_policy.education: Substantially increase public school funding; free community college and subsidised university tuition; cancel predatory student debt; invest in early childhood education.
social_policy.housing: Major public investment in affordable and social housing; zoning reform to increase density; strengthen tenant protections and fair-rent mechanisms; housing-first approach to homelessness.
social_policy.civil_rights: Comprehensive anti-discrimination protections; pay equity enforcement; reproductive rights; expand voting access; restorative justice for historic injustices.
social_policy.immigration: Humane, orderly immigration policy; pathway to legal status for long-term undocumented residents; expand refugee resettlement; invest in integration services; protect asylum seekers' rights.

governance.decentralization: Strong national standards with empowered local government; participatory budgeting pilots; strengthen public-sector unions and collective bargaining.
governance.transparency: Public financing of elections to reduce corporate influence; mandatory lobbying disclosure; revolving-door restrictions between government and industry.
governance.electoral_reform: Proportional representation; lower barriers to voter registration; ranked-choice voting; campaign finance reform to amplify small donors.

environment.climate_action: Net-zero emissions by 2045 through public investment and regulation; carbon pricing with revenue recycled to low-income households; green industrial policy creating good jobs.
environment.energy: Rapid expansion of renewables and nuclear; managed phase-out of fossil fuels with transition support for affected workers and communities; public investment in grid modernisation.
environment.conservation: Strengthen environmental protections; expand protected areas; environmental justice framework prioritising vulnerable communities; sustainable agriculture incentives.

security.defense: Adequate defence spending focused on modern threats; prioritise diplomacy and multilateral cooperation; reform military procurement to reduce waste.
security.law_enforcement: Community-oriented policing with accountability and oversight; invest in crime prevention through social programmes; reform sentencing to reduce mass incarceration; end private prisons.
security.foreign_policy: Multilateral engagement through international institutions; promote human rights and democratic governance abroad; generous but accountable foreign aid; peaceful conflict resolution.
